name: Trace data through three functions
short_description: Trace data through three functions once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can trace data through three functions in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Trace data through three functions means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Trace data through three functions in a fresh real-life scenario.
